bundle.longDescription: Cloud Drive Bridge connects any S3-compatible bucket — Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO, Wasabi and more — lets you browse, upload, download and share files, and mounts the bucket as a local drive on Windows, macOS and Linux. Your own keys (BYOK) stay in your OS keychain. Free and open source (MIT).
bundle.shortDescription: Mount S3, R2, B2, MinIO & Wasabi buckets as a local drive. Free, open source, BYOK.
